milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the polished blackstone brick stairs structure (centered at spawn-relative [6, 1, 5]) and face toward it, confirming visual observation. Target is the center of the staircase structure.
Uses inventory_has because crafting a stone_pressure_plate places it in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 stone_pressure_plates, so having ≥1 confirms successful crafting.
